report.summary: The factory-reset arming and the re-opening voice window are fixed and verified (no press can schedule a wipe, LONG_PRESS_UP is gone, a matched phrase/timeout clears the flag), but the reset is still not the spec's factory reset: on this board it is a 10 s hold of the settings/– button, reachable by any user of the panel, with no MODE, no volume combination and no second confirmation.

previousFindingsStatus.finding: critical — a short press arms the factory-reset countdown, cancelled only by a release
previousFindingsStatus.evidence: app_logic.cpp:239-245 on_set_press now only sets s_combo.set_down; the timer is armed exclusively by on_set_arm (app_logic.cpp:247-258), registered on BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_START with COMBO_ARM_MS = 1000 (app_logic.cpp:375-376); on_set_release :260-266 stops it. A tap can no longer schedule a wipe.

previousFindingsStatus.finding: warning — LONG_PRESS_UP window can fire early or miss a long hold
previousFindingsStatus.evidence: The BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_UP registration and on_set_long_hold are removed; the wipe is performed by s_fr_timer -> factory_reset_cb (app_logic.cpp:214-221, armed :254-256).

previousFindingsStatus.finding: warning — a recognised phrase left s_btn_window set, so the window re-opened
previousFindingsStatus.evidence: app_audio.cpp:190-192 clears s_btn_window before audio_apply_command on ESP_MN_STATE_DETECTED, :194-197 on ESP_MN_STATE_TIMEOUT; the button branch :164-170 only opens when !listening.

previousFindingsStatus.finding: info — control.cpp comment claimed the single-click registration was removed
previousFindingsStatus.evidence: control.cpp:119-122 now states the weak hook is overridden in app_logic.cpp and that this is what runs.

previousFindingsStatus.finding: info — 6 s MultiNet window vs the 10 s panel bar

findings.description: The factory reset is not the documented one. The spec's trigger is 'hold the front SET and MODE buttons together for 10 s', i.e. a deliberate two-finger combination that a normal user cannot hit while operating the panel; the firmware now resets on a 10 s hold of the single ADC-group button handle — the same button whose short click is push-to-talk and whose other members are the volume keys. The writer's report acknowledges this is 'unobservable on this board' instead of resolving it, so a spec-mandated safety behaviour is implemented as an easier-to-trigger gesture than the spec allows.
findings.failureScenario: A user resting a finger on the panel's front button while reading the screen, or a child holding it down, holds it for 10 s: on_set_arm (app_logic.cpp:247) starts the countdown, factory_reset_cb runs, heating_factory_reset() erases NVS and reboots — Wi-Fi, broker and the four room topics are gone and the panel drops to the onboarding AP. No combination, no confirmation, and the only visible warning is a banner that the panel's dim screen may hide.
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp:373-376 (`button_event_args_t lp = {}; lp.long_press.press_time = COMBO_ARM_MS; iot_button_register_cb(s_combo.set, BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_START, &lp, on_set_arm, NULL);`) on handles[0] only (:362); app_logic.cpp:247-258 on_set_arm, :214-221 factory_reset_cb -> heating_factory_reset (heating.cpp:395-401 nvs_flash_erase + esp_restart); spec.json factoryReset.trigger 'Hold the front SET and MODE buttons together for 10 s'.
findings.suggestedChange: Keep the wipe behind a combination the spec allows — e.g. hold SET (handles[0]) while VOLUME_UP (the group's fourth handle, which reports presses through the same iot_button adc_multi device) is also down, or require the SET hold to be confirmed by a second gesture within the countdown — and record the deviation explicitly in the product description if a single-button hold is the only option on this board.

findings.description: The 'START' event can be delivered more than once for one press while s_combo.set_down is still true, and each delivery re-arms: iot_button dispatches BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_START per `s_combo.set_down` state, so any repeat (a second registered START callback, or a re-entry while the handle stays down) restarts the FR_HOLD_MS timer, extending the hold beyond the spec's 10 s and firing the wipe a second time relative to the press.
findings.failureScenario: Hold the button: on_set_arm fires at 1 s and starts a 10 s timer. If the long-press event is delivered again during the same press (e.g. iot_button's hold/repeat handling keeps the device in the long-press state and the callback re-runs), esp_timer_stop/start_once pushes the wipe to 11 s, 12 s … so a user holding exactly 10 s (as the banner says) sees no reset, contradicts 'Reset in 10 s', and the reset eventually lands at an unpredictable time.
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp:247-258 on_set_arm (`if (!s_combo.set_down) return; heating_ui_banner(...); esp_timer_stop(s_fr_timer); esp_timer_start_once(...)`); iot_button.c:154-171 LONG_PRESS_START dispatch loop with callbacks matching press_time.
findings.suggestedChange: Arm once per press: guard on_set_arm with a flag cleared in on_set_press/on_set_release so a repeat event cannot restart the countdown, and make the countdown length equal FR_HOLD_MS − COMBO_ARM_MS so the total hold is the advertised 10 s.

MQTT: publish {"current_heating_setpoint": "<x.y>"} to zigbee2mqtt/<TRV>; {"time": 254} to zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join; subscribe each TRV and air-sensor topic per session; retained status zerocode/<mac>/status with last-will offline. HTTP /settings, /api/state, /api/set.

app_logic_init (heating_load_targets, timers, button bindings, console cmd)
expectedLogPatterns: app_audio: "button press — listening for a command", "command phrase <id>", "no command heard — sleeping until next trigger"
app_mqtt: "SoftAP 'Korvo-Heating-XXXX' (password 'heatpanel') — open http://korvo-heating.local/settings", "Wi-Fi got IP", "MQTT connected"
heating_panel: "front buttons bound (1) — click = push-to-talk, double click = dismiss, hold 10000 ms = factory reset", "front button held for 10000 ms — wiping settings"
notes: Factory reset is a single-button 10 s hold (documented deviation), not the spec's SET+MODE combination.
No press alone can schedule a wipe any more; the countdown starts at 1 s of hold.
A matched voice command and the AFE timeout both clear the button flag, so the mic cannot re-open by itself.
